title: CAL Lights
description: a lighting graphics engine created specifically for animation
body:
# Welcome to CAL Lights!
A lighting engine created specifically for use in BBS animations and more!

![CALBanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/317f30183ed41b7f2fcd58b8abea0f5a223142e3_0.webp)

# Fog density
You can play with the fog density for your miniatures or areas of your world when required.

![Enderman](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a89f767dc3f1d8424eccd67da8c4bdead5496b61_0.webp)

# Spotlights
Spotlights are directional lights; you can play with them to your liking, directing the light wherever you want it to be emitted.

![Villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e22e882ee42564ddcbe4d50bad75c8282c2dbe2_0.webp)

# Pointlights
Pointlights are lights that emit light from six sides, or all sides, like a sphere. This type of light is very useful for scenes where a torch is used inside a cave—what a mysterious sight!

![Caves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2767c04f78184e1b2421bcf6417862d405e24c86_0.webp)

# internal animation system
If you want to use these lights for events, maps, or whatever else you can think of, you can use CAL Lights' internal animation system. Imagine using these lights for... I don't know, backrooms?

![Animations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17450724fa27f6aed5ebe7d5d579c6cb64ada955_0.webp)

# BBS CML compatibility
CAL Lights has BBS CML compatibility, where you can use it as a replay for your animations. If you plan to use it for first-person videos, you'll have to wait a bit, as there are some bugs, but I'll be working on it for future versions.

![BBS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebe8c29203e7423e1c17063600d0ad4f4a32543d_0.webp)

# Author's Note

There are more features I'd like to mention, but they're still being refined, such as light filters (gobos), shadows, and outlines. I'm leaving these features as experimental, so you can use them without problems while I refine them over time.

**The shader patches currently supported are:**

- ComplementaryReimagined_r5.8.1
- BSL_v10.0 CAL Patch

Any suggestions, bug reports, or help can be sent to the Discord server: BBS CML COMMUNITY, which is available in the links or networks section of the Modrinth and Curseforge platforms.
